name: [#ff5959]Swordium []Core
description:
A core made out of [#ff5959]swordium[], made for mobile bases, can be upgraded to any core of your choice that's larger than 3x3.
[red]disclaimer: avoid deconstructing this core if it's the only core in the sector!
details: remember to plan the location if you're planning to upgrade the core, because once upgraded, it cannot be deconstructed.
